Who is involved when

One family, one roadmap, five professionals who overlap. This is the sequence: who enters at which step, who hands off to whom, and where two or three of us are working at the same time.

One family, one roadmap, five professionals who overlap. A solid bar is the step that professional leads; a light bar is where they stay involved. The care consultant starts first, and her care planning and care management carry on after the Medicaid work is done.
